claim: VIF wraps outputs in cryptographic witness envelopes containing provenance and confidence.
VIF enforces κ-gating to prevent low-confidence responses (abstain if confidence < 0.70).
VIF consists of four core components: Witness Generator, κ-Gating Module, Confidence Calibrator, and Provenance Tracker.
VIF integrates with CMC for witness storage, HHNI for retrieval witnessing, APOE for execution gates, SEG for provenance chains.
VIF provides deterministic replay through complete witness envelopes and provenance chains.
Confidence thresholds: Tier S (0.95), Tier A (0.90), Tier B (0.85), Tier C (0.80).
VIF witness envelopes include: model ID, weights hash, prompt template ID, tool IDs, writer, confidence band, entropy.
VIF confidence calibration uses historical accuracy data to improve confidence score accuracy.
VIF enables human-in-the-loop escalation when confidence drops below threshold.
VIF provides replay protection through cryptographic witness envelopes and deterministic replay.
Calibration CLI computes expected calibration error (ECE) and logs deltas for audit.
Witness APIs store provenance and enforce Tier A thresholds via command server hooks.
READY_TO_EXECUTE.md records the Wave 1 confidence workflow (Ch01→Ch02→Ch04 order).
Command server validates persona authority before executing `track_confidence`.
